dec.pe: Men from Bosnia were taken to build in Azerbaijan, had their passports taken and were not paid. The authorities did not investigate. The Court found a breach of the duty to investigate.
dec.pi: Pria dari Bosnia dibawa untuk membangun di Azerbaijan, paspornya ditahan dan tidak digaji. Pihak berwenang tidak menyelidiki. Mahkamah menemukan pelanggaran kewajiban menyelidiki.
